trials.claimQuote: ChartBrick: $49 (was $107.88) - Lifetime access to ChartBrick - You must redeem your code(s) within 60 days
trials.reasoning: A buyer reports paying for the lifetime deal but having it suspended and being downgraded to the 3-chart free plan; the terms statement about price changes does not address this.

exhibits.quote: However, despite paying $50 for this LTD, my deal was mysteriously suspended, and ChartBrick now claims I’ve hit the limit for their "free plan" (limited to 3 charts), which I never signed up for!
exhibits.argument: Buyer reports lifetime deal was suspended and downgraded to free-plan limits despite paying for lifetime access.

exhibits.quote: Lifetime deals purchased before a price change are not affected.
exhibits.argument: The vendor's own terms confirm lifetime deals exist and retain their terms.

trials.claimQuote: All data sources - Unlimited charts - Unlimited dashboards - Unlimited datasets - Unlimited sharing & live embeds - AI chart generation
trials.reasoning: The terms state the Unlimited plan has no preset numerical caps on charts and a buyer confirms satisfaction with unlimited charts; the terms only reserve action for materially disproportionate or abusive use.

exhibits.quote: We reserve the right to review usage that is materially disproportionate to typical use (for example, abusive automation, hosting embeds on traffic at the scale of a major media site, or behaviour that degrades the Service for other users), and to introduce limits or additional charges in those cases.
exhibits.argument: Vendor reserves right to introduce limits or extra charges, which voids the promise of truly unlimited charts.

exhibits.quote: I paid for unlimited access, yet now I’m being treated like a free user.
exhibits.argument: Buyer with unlimited deal reports being limited as a free user, contradicting unlimited charts.

exhibits.quote: The Unlimited plan is sold without preset numerical caps on charts, dashboards, datasets, or embed views.
exhibits.argument: The vendor states the Unlimited plan has no preset numerical caps on charts.

exhibits.quote: So, I am very satisfied with the product and the price for unlimited charts!
exhibits.argument: A buyer confirms satisfaction with the product and price for unlimited charts.

trials.reasoning: The terms state the Unlimited plan has no preset numerical caps on dashboards; the reserved right applies only to materially disproportionate or abusive use.

exhibits.argument: Vendor reserves right to introduce limits or extra charges, which voids the promise of truly unlimited dashboards.

trials.reasoning: The cited term only prohibits sharing beyond the seats included in a plan and does not state how many members this workspace plan includes, so it neither confirms nor contradicts unlimited members.

exhibits.quote: Share, resell, or otherwise transfer access to your account (including a lifetime deal account) to people beyond the seats included in your plan.
exhibits.argument: Terms prohibit sharing beyond included seats, which contradicts unlimited members on one workspace.

trials.claimQuote: You must redeem your code(s) within 60 days of purchase - All future plan updates - Please note: This deal
trials.reasoning: The maintenance clause and one review calling the project abandoned do not show whether lifetime buyers are included in or excluded from any future plan updates.

exhibits.quote: We may perform maintenance, ship updates, change features, or temporarily suspend parts of the Service at any time.
exhibits.argument: Vendor can change features at any time with no uptime commitment, undermining guaranteed future plan updates.

exhibits.quote: It is more or less an abandonware. I recommend looking into alternatives, as it seems this project has been largely abandoned.
exhibits.argument: Buyer reports project is abandoned, contradicting promise of ongoing future updates.

trials.claimQuote: Please note: This deal is not stackable - All data sources - Unlimited charts - Unlimited dashboards - Unlimited datasets
trials.reasoning: Two buyers consistently report being unable to connect Google Sheets, materially limiting the promised access to all data sources despite it being listed.

exhibits.quote: Also it not connecting to google sheets also hampered my ability to use it effectively.
exhibits.argument: Buyer reports Google Sheets connection does not work, contradicting all data sources included.

exhibits.quote: I was not able to connect my Google sheets to it as Google restricted access to personal data.
exhibits.argument: Buyer reports inability to connect Google Sheets due to unverified access, contradicting all data sources included.

exhibits.quote: ChartBrick lets you connect data sources (CSV, Excel, JSON, MySQL, PostgreSQL, Google Sheets, Airtable, Notion, Stackby), build charts and dashboards
exhibits.argument: The vendor lists the full set of connectable data sources for building charts.

exhibits.quote: its ability to connect with various data sources, such as Notion, Airtable, Stackby, Google Sheets, MySQL databases and even CSV upload
exhibits.argument: A buyer confirms the ability to connect to various data sources works.

themes.summary: Several buyers report crashes and broken Google Sheets connections.

hits.quote: when I attempted to upload a large CSV file with 10,000 rows, the platform was unable to handle it and crashed.
I was not able to connect my Google sheets to it as Google restricted access to personal data.
Also it not connecting to google sheets also hampered my ability to use it effectively.

It works very well. Has a clean interface. Easy to use.
